name: ci-ubuntu-24.04-kvm-lane
setup: GitHub-hosted ubuntu-24.04 runner (4 vCPU, shared), QEMU/KVM Linux VM Space (2 vCPU, 2 GiB), same host, through the cua daemon, with this tree's cua-spacesd and the image's udev rule overlaid so the bulk lane carries files of 2 MiB and more. Each value is the median of nine runs of this workflow from 2026-10-20 to 2026-10-23 on the same code path: the hosted pool mixes faster and slower hosts, and one run's exec p50 ranged from 1.6 to 4.2 ms with rpc_health moving with it, so a baseline from a single fast host failed slower hosts at 2x. Upload is bound by the guest's disk writes here, not by the transport. p50 only: hosted runners are too noisy for p95, and the workflow allows 2x; the absolute targets still hold exec to 5 ms.
